summaries.en: DeepAgents is an agent harness built with LangChain and LangGraph that enables AI systems to tackle complex, multi-step tasks through structured planning and execution. Its key innovation lies in using a planning tool and filesystem backend to break down problems into manageable sub-tasks, which can be delegated to specialized subagents. Developers can use it to build sophisticated AI assistants for research automation, data analysis pipelines, or workflow orchestration by defining custom agent roles and task hierarchies.
summaries.zh: DeepAgents是一个基于LangChain和LangGraph构建的智能体框架，专门解决需要多步骤规划和执行的复杂AI任务。它通过内置的规划工具和文件系统后端，将复杂问题分解为可管理的子任务，并能够动态创建专门化的子智能体进行协同处理。这种分层架构让开发者能够构建研究助手、数据分析流水线或工作流协调系统，通过定义不同的智能体角色和任务层级来实现灵活的任务自动化。

summaries.en: Claudian is an Obsidian plugin that integrates Claude Code as an AI collaborator directly within your knowledge vault, addressing the need for seamless AI assistance during note-taking and research workflows. It works by embedding Claude's coding capabilities into Obsidian's interface, allowing real-time code generation and explanation without switching applications. Users can install it via Obsidian's community plugins, then invoke Claude Code through commands or hotkeys to get coding help, debug scripts, or generate documentation while maintaining their workflow context.
summaries.zh: Claudian 是一款 Obsidian 插件，将 Claude Code 作为 AI 协作者嵌入知识库中，解决了在笔记和研究过程中需要频繁切换工具获取编程帮助的问题。它通过 TypeScript 实现深度集成，让用户能在 Obsidian 界面内直接调用 Claude 的代码生成与解释功能，保持工作流连贯性。使用时只需通过社区插件安装，即可用快捷键或命令唤出 Claude Code，实时获得代码建议、调试脚本或生成文档，特别适合开发者、研究者和技术写作者在构建知识体系时同步进行编程实践。

summaries.en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.
summaries.zh: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
